runtime_policy: Evidence files are review material only. Runtime thresholds and models must use separately versioned, tested policy/configuration.

sources.title: Recommended Amount of Sleep for a Healthy Adult: A Joint Consensus Statement of the AASM and SRS
sources.license: open access; see article rights statement
sources.use_in_zeep: Adult overnight duration reference: regular sleep of at least seven hours supports health.
sources.limitations: Not a fixed target for naps, meditation, recovery modes or every individual.

sources.title: Sleep staging from electrocardiography and respiration with deep learning
sources.license: open access; see article rights statement
sources.use_in_zeep: Evidence that cardiac and respiratory dynamics plus temporal context contain sleep-stage information.
sources.limitations: ECG and respiratory-effort model results are not direct validation of ZEEP BCG.

sources.title: Sleep Parameter Assessment Accuracy of a Consumer Home Sleep Monitoring Ballistocardiograph Beddit Sleep Tracker
sources.license: open access; see article rights statement
sources.use_in_zeep: BCG validation caution for TST, WASO and stage classification.
sources.limitations: Different product and algorithm; small healthy-adult sample.

sources.title: A validation study of a ballistocardiograph sleep tracker against polysomnography
sources.license: open access; see article rights statement
sources.use_in_zeep: Supports strict signal-quality gates, Unknown states and PSG validation before clinical claims.
sources.limitations: Different sensor and algorithm; does not estimate ZEEP performance.

sources.title: AASM Consumer Sleep Technology Position Statement
sources.use_in_zeep: Wellness and patient-generated data boundary; not a replacement for clinical evaluation.
sources.limitations: Check the publisher page for the current position before external claims.

sources.title: AASM Manual for the Scoring of Sleep and Associated Events
sources.license: AASM licensed content; do not redistribute
sources.use_in_zeep: Authoritative PSG definitions and scoring terminology for W, N1, N2, N3 and REM.
sources.limitations: BCG-only estimates are not AASM PSG scoring and the manual must be accessed under its terms.

sources.title: Clinical Practice Guideline for Diagnostic Testing for Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea
sources.license: open access; see article rights statement
sources.use_in_zeep: Guardrail separating ZEEP wellness estimation from diagnosis of sleep apnea.
sources.limitations: Clinical practice guidance, not a ZEEP score formula.

sources.title: WHO Global Health Observatory
sources.use_in_zeep: Discovery and verification of current population-health datasets.
sources.limitations: Record dataset, geography, definition, extraction date and licence for every use.

sources.title: WHO Data
sources.use_in_zeep: Current WHO data portal and indicator definitions.
sources.limitations: Population data must not be treated as an individual clinical reference without review.

sources.title: Human transport of thirdhand tobacco smoke: A prominent source of hazardous air pollutants into indoor nonsmoking environments
sources.license: open access; see article rights statement
sources.use_in_zeep: Direct evidence that people and clothing can transport tobacco-related VOCs into nonsmoking indoor spaces.
sources.limitations: Mass-spectrometry study in a theater; it does not prove the source of a ZEEP SGP40 event.

sources.title: Emission Rates of Volatile Organic Compounds from Humans
sources.license: open access; see article rights statement
sources.use_in_zeep: Human breath and skin are normal VOC sources affected by air conditions and clothing.
sources.limitations: Chamber group emission rates are not personal baselines or toxicology thresholds.

sources.title: Identification and determination of the volatile organics of third-hand smoke from different cigarettes and clothing fabrics
sources.license: open access; see article rights statement
sources.use_in_zeep: Evidence that tobacco VOCs can off-gas from fabrics and that fabric type matters.
sources.limitations: Controlled fabric experiment, not a field attribution method.

sources.title: Volatile organic compounds as breath biomarkers for active and passive smoking
sources.use_in_zeep: Supports time-dependent tobacco-related VOCs in breath after exposure.
sources.limitations: Specific biomarkers require selective analytical instruments; SGP40 is non-specific.

sources.title: Utilization of breath analysis for exposure estimates of benzene associated with active smoking
sources.use_in_zeep: Evidence that breath benzene can be elevated shortly after smoking.
sources.limitations: Cannot be measured selectively with SGP40.

sources.title: WHO global air quality guidelines
sources.use_in_zeep: Health evidence for PM and major ambient pollutants.
sources.limitations: Averaging times and ambient scope must not be converted directly into ten-second POD alarms.

sources.title: WHO housing and health guidelines
sources.use_in_zeep: Built-environment health and safety design context.
sources.limitations: Not written specifically for a sleep pod.

sources.title: WHO guidelines for indoor air quality: selected pollutants
sources.use_in_zeep: Health context for selected indoor chemical pollutants.
sources.limitations: SGP40 cannot identify or quantify individual pollutants in this guideline.

sources.title: Roadmap to improve and ensure good indoor ventilation in the context of COVID-19
sources.use_in_zeep: Ventilation assessment and operational-response design reference.
sources.limitations: COVID-19 context requires engineering adaptation for ZEEP.

sources.title: Methods for sampling and analysis of chemical pollutants in indoor air
sources.use_in_zeep: Methodological reference for confirmatory indoor chemical sampling.
sources.limitations: Public-setting/children scope; not a direct ZEEP pass/fail standard.

sources.title: WHO report on the global tobacco epidemic, 2025: warning about the dangers of tobacco
sources.use_in_zeep: Current global tobacco-control report in the reviewed library.
sources.limitations: Population and policy evidence cannot attribute an individual sensor event.

sources.title: Tobacco Control Playbook: comprehensive smoke-free legislation
sources.use_in_zeep: Smoke-free environment and tobacco-control governance context.
sources.limitations: Not a sensor calibration or source-attribution method.

sources.title: WHO Tobacco and nicotine fact sheet
sources.use_in_zeep: Current public-health summary for tobacco, nicotine and second-hand smoke.
sources.limitations: Live page; checked version dated 26 June 2026 and must be rechecked before citation.

sources.title: Sensirion SGP40 Datasheet
sources.license: Sensirion copyright; local technical reference only
sources.use_in_zeep: Electrical, SRAW_VOC and temperature/humidity compensation contract.
sources.limitations: Vendor technical evidence is not clinical evidence.

sources.title: SGP40 VOC Index for Experts, version 1.1
sources.license: Sensirion copyright; local technical reference only
sources.use_in_zeep: Interpretation of adaptive VOC Index and transient events.
sources.limitations: Non-specific relative index; it cannot identify a chemical or person.
